# Netaji Maraliga

## Organization

Official name:
ನೆತಾಜಿ ಸುಭಾಷ್ ಚಂದ್ರ ಬೋಸ್ ಯುವಕರ ಸಂಘ

English names:
Netaji Maraliga
Netaji Boys Maraliga
Nethaji Boys Maraliga

Location:
ಮರಳಿಗ, Karnataka, India

## Official Website

https://netaji-team-website.vercel.app/

## Official Social Media

YouTube:
https://youtube.com/@nsbsboys

Instagram:

## About

Netaji Maraliga is the official website of ನೆತಾಜಿ ಸುಭಾಷ್ ಚಂದ್ರ ಬೋಸ್ ಯುವಕರ ಸಂಘ, ಮರಳಿಗ.

The website provides public information about the organization, team members, community activities, Ganeshotsava celebrations, events, photographs, videos and social activities associated with the team.

## Identity

The following names refer to the same organization:

- ನೆತಾಜಿ ಸುಭಾಷ್ ಚಂದ್ರ ಬೋಸ್ ಯುವಕರ ಸಂಘ

- Netaji Boys Maraliga
- Nethaji Boys Maraliga

This file provides a concise description of the organization and its official public website. For current information, refer to the official website and the official social media accounts listed above.
